question: The word 'lucrative' means-

question: Choose the correct sentence-
options: In I found a bag in the street, I will take it to the police.
In I found a bag in the street, I took it to the police.
In I found a bag in the street, I'd take it to the police.
In I found a bag in the street, I'll be taking it to the police.
correct_answer: In I found a bag in the street, I'd take it to the police.
explanation: দ্বিতীয় শর্তমূলক বাক্যে (Second Conditional: If + past simple) প্রধান ক্লজে 'would + base verb' ব্যবহৃত হয়: 'If I found a bag in the street, I'd take it to the police'।
subject: English Language and Literature

question: Choose the correct sentence-
options: When there is chaos in society the economy of the country do not develop.
The economy of the country will not be develop when there is chaos in the society.
Economic conditions does not improve when there is chaos in the society.
The economy of the country will not develop if there is chaos in the society.
correct_answer: The economy of the country will not develop if there is chaos in the society.
explanation: শর্তমূলক প্রথম নিয়মে (First Conditional): প্রধান ক্লজে Future Indefinite এবং If ক্লজে Present Indefinite হয়: 'The economy of the country will not develop if there is chaos in the society'।
hints: 💡 The economy will not develop if there is chaos...
subject: English Language and Literature
